entities.name: PMID:25092649
observations: Toxicological Sciences (2014) primary study: kinase-dead AMPKα2 transgenic mice with reduced AMPKα1/α2 activity were protected from paraquat-induced cardiac contractile dysfunction; pharmacologic autophagy inhibition supported autophagy involvement.

entities.name: AMPK-PQ cardiac rescue
observations: In a mouse/cardiomyocyte paraquat model, reduced AMPK activity attenuated contractile and Ca2+-handling dysfunction and reduced autophagy-pathway signaling.
Autophagy mediation is supported by pharmacologic inhibition, but strict necessity is not conclusively established by the reported evidence.
